submission.natural_language_explanation: Induction-style head: active on the second (or later) occurrence of a rare word, name or identifier that splits into several tokens, typically on its first or middle pieces ('k' of a repeated 'xkcd', 'organic' of a repeated 'Inorganic', 'ull' of a repeated 'Skullpocket'), where it attends to the token that followed the earlier copy. A first mention of the same word is inactive. Ordinary prose with no repeated rare word is inactive; repeated common words (the, of, and), list commas and parallel list items ('Monday ..., Tuesday ..., Wednesday') rarely and only weakly cross the line (about 0.25-0.35 of max).
